messages:
anna: quick heads-up — planning a staggered rollout tomorrow 02:00 UTC for engine-kernel v3.4 + quant build Q2. The plan: small shards -> regional fanout -> full. Need final signoff on perf snapshot and rollback criteria.

 dave: thumbs, do we have the perf snapshot uploaded? link? :eyes:

 maria: uploaded to artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/runtimes/v3.4/perf-snap-2026-03-18.tar.gz

 raj: quick checklist from my side: smoke tests, kv-cache sanity, p99 latency < 120ms, cpu% steady, no mem-growth > 5% after 30m. If any fail, we abort and pin previous image.

 anna: agreed. propose pin TTL=3h during the window so ops can roll back quickly if needed. also want a canary fanout by shard-id not by region — less noise for global traffic.

 dave: +1 for shard fanout. we should also gate on "quant-mismatch" metric (model output diffs) and "matmul-error-rate" — if either spikes > 2x baseline, immediate pin.

 maria: added those to the checklist. release-notes draft in /docs/release-notes/engine-v3.4.md (internal). who owns the post-deploy smoke?

 raj: I'll own smoke and eviction checks for first 45m. @dave please take tracing/latency dashboards.

 anna: deploybot commands we will run: ```/deploy start engine-v3.4 --strategy=staggered --shard-step=5% --watch=5m``` then after canary pass: ```/deploy fanout engine-v3.4 --by=shard --step=25% --watch=10m```. Pin command if abort: ```/deploy pin engine-v3.3 --reason="rollback: kernel perf regress" --ttl=3h```

 deploybot: preflight checks complete:
 - image integrity: OK
 - binary signature: OK
 - staging smoke: OK (0 failures)
 - perf-snapshot compare: p50 +2ms, p95 +6ms, p99 +9ms
 - quant mismatch baseline: 0.3% (within 0.5% threshold)

 anna: nice. one more: add a holdback group of 2 shards that we never touch until +2h post deploy. that helps for quick fallback verification.

 dave: noted. I'll attach alert runbooks to the rollout message and create a short dashboard with the three gating signals (p99, quant-mismatch, matmul-error-rate).

 maria: release notes checklist: short summary, compatibility note for pinned customers, rollback instructions, links to perf snapshot + artifact. I'll publish once final signoff.

 raj: rollback criteria (formal): any of the following within watch windows -> immediate pin and abort:
 - p99 > 2x baseline or > 200ms for > 3 consecutive intervals
 - quant-mismatch > 1% absolute increase vs staging baseline
 - matmul-error-rate > 0.1% absolute OR any OOMs on hosts
 - kv-cache miss rate increase > 10% sustained over 10m

 anna: timeline: 02:00 start, canary (5% shards) -> 02:10 check -> 02:30 25% fanout -> 02:50 75% -> 03:10 full. Holdback verification at +2h. All hands on slack channel if any gating fires.

 dave: I'll be on-call for the window. @oncall-bot please escalate to infra-pager for any OOMs or host-restarts.

 oncall-bot: escalation set: infra-pager -> oncall-duty. Thresholds: host-restart >=1 within 10m -> page.

 maria: one more: we should annotate commit sha in release notes and set a short-lived feature flag to force previous path for a percentage of traffic in case we need A/B rollback. I'll add the flag and the feature-flag toggle command to the notes.

 anna: perfect. final ask — everyone react to this thread with :thumbsup: once you're happy. I'll kick off the deploy at the window and keep updates in-thread.

 dave: :thumbsup:

 maria: :thumbsup:

 raj: :thumbsup:

 anna: starting pre-deploy grooming in 30m. thanks all.

 deploybot: scheduled job created: job_id=deploy-3501234567-1, start=3501312000 (02:00 UTC 2026-03-19), strategy=staggered, shard_step=5%, holdback=2 shards. Logs will post here.
